# P1.2 has one explicit bounded multi-package metadata manifest

Source: [JSON](../../decisions/D108.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Date

2026-09-20

## Status

accepted

## Decision

The ordinary ≤8-files/one-package rule remains unchanged. P1.2 is the sole bounded
exception: an explicit sorted manifest names exactly 20 existing package
`composer.json` files plus `docs/architecture/taxonomy.md`, root `CHANGELOG.md`, and
`@plan/knowledge/findings-P1-receipts.json`.
Writes in package files are mechanically limited to `extra.corex`; expansion to an
unlisted package/file fails. Validation compares the actual write set to the manifest
and proves all non-`extra.corex` JSON bytes semantically unchanged.

## Rationale

Splitting identical metadata into 20 sessions would multiply shared-context risk while
the wildcard hid the true scope. A finite manifest makes the exceptional scope honest
and machine-checkable without weakening the default budget.

## D108 — P1.2 has one explicit bounded multi-package metadata manifest

**Actor:** plan-designer/codex-gpt-5.6-sol/high
**Evidence:** `RAG:—` DA14 expands the wildcard to 20 package manifests plus two
root documents, exceeding the ordinary item file/package limits.

## Решение

The ordinary ≤8-files/one-package rule remains unchanged. P1.2 is the sole bounded
exception: an explicit sorted manifest names exactly 20 existing package
`composer.json` files plus `docs/architecture/taxonomy.md`, root `CHANGELOG.md`, and
`@plan/knowledge/findings-P1-receipts.json`.
Writes in package files are mechanically limited to `extra.corex`; expansion to an
unlisted package/file fails. Validation compares the actual write set to the manifest
and proves all non-`extra.corex` JSON bytes semantically unchanged.

## Почему

Splitting identical metadata into 20 sessions would multiply shared-context risk while
the wildcard hid the true scope. A finite manifest makes the exceptional scope honest
and machine-checkable without weakening the default budget.

## Consequences

P1.2 lists every path literally, includes the receipt in that manifest, and emits an
expanded-write-set receipt. No owner gate or authority grant is created.
